_about: S26b — a stored shelf snap (the NDJSON the route streams: the shelf read, then the final body), a Compare to re-run against a shelf bottle, and a single-bottle snap. Names are real store wines; prices and taste positions are illustrative. Used by scripts/pw-s26b-shelf.cjs.

shelf.name: Villa Maria Private Bin Sauvignon Blanc

detected_item.name: Kim Crawford Sauvignon Blanc
detected_item.description: Dry and zesty — grapefruit and cut grass with a sharp, mouthwatering finish. Most of this shelf runs in the same bright Marlborough lane.

similar.name: Whitehaven Sauvignon Blanc
similar.description: Similarly dry, a touch riper. The passionfruit sits up front and the acid follows close behind. Keeps the zing and adds a little fruit.

similar.name: Matua Sauvignon Blanc
similar.description: Similarly dry, lighter on its feet. Lime and green pepper, then a quick clean finish. Trades depth for snap.

similar.name: Villa Maria Private Bin Sauvignon Blanc
similar.description: A shade softer. Tropical fruit leads and the herbs stay quiet. Rounds off the edges.

similar.name: Nobilo Sauvignon Blanc
similar.description: Similarly dry, more herbal. Grass and gooseberry carry it, with a chalky finish. Doubles down on the green notes.

similar.name: Dashwood Sauvignon Blanc
similar.description: Slightly fuller. Citrus up front, a little weight through the middle. Keeps the brightness with more body.

reks.name: Starborough Sauvignon Blanc
reks.description: Similarly dry, brighter. Lime zest and a flinty edge. Keeps the snap.

wine.vsFavorite: a touch drier, more lime, similar body

reks.name: Matua Sauvignon Blanc

reks.name: Giesen Sauvignon Blanc

detected_item.name: Kendall-Jackson Vintner's Reserve Chardonnay
detected_item.description: Off-dry leaning and buttery — baked apple and vanilla over a creamy middle.

similar.name: La Crema Sonoma Coast Chardonnay
similar.description: Drier and brighter. Citrus leads before the oak. Trades butter for lift.

similar.name: Josh Cellars Chardonnay
similar.description: Similarly soft. Pear and vanilla, gentle finish. Keeps the roundness.

similar.name: Bogle Chardonnay
similar.description: Similarly buttery. Toasted oak up front. Doubles down on the oak.
